messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in 5xx rate and token latency on model family 'thorn13b' starting now. auto-escalation to on-call.
oncall-jordan: seeing it, pulling charts now. which metric is most noisy?
runtime-lee: p50 token latency up from 80ms -> 420ms, queue length jumped. link: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/tx/thorn13b
sre-maya: thanks. error profile looks like function-call payloads are causing big KV-cache churn. if we can suspend funcall execution for thorn13b we should reduce memory churn.
prod-ana: quick question — which customers are affected? any enterprise SLAs at risk?
support-sam: customers hitting thorn13b: api-cms, searchly, chatkit. top 2 have steady traffic. I'll start proactive notices after we have mitigation timeline.
oncall-jordan: plan: 1) lower RPM/TPM for thorn13b to reduce concurrent inflight 2) disable function-calls for thorn13b as temporary mitigation 3) monitor for 10m then iterate. agree?
runtime-lee: agree. suggested commands:
```
# reduce quotas
redwoodctl quota set --model thorn13b --rpm 25 --tpm 15000 --reason "emergency mitigation 1767204321"
# disable funcalls on routing layer
redwoodctl model update --model thorn13b --feature funcall_enabled=false --reason "emergency mitigation"
```
oncall-jordan: executing now. posting results.
oncall-jordan: ran quota command — API returned 200. new RPM=25 TPM=15000. ran funcall toggle — feature flag set to false. routing config pushed to edge clusters.
runtime-lee: seeing initial improvement: p50 token latency down to 210ms, queue length halved. errors trending down.
sre-maya: adding a temporary tenant carveout rule for high-priority customers to prevent impact: `--allowlist api-cms:500rpm searchly:300rpm` so they keep minimal capacity.
oncall-jordan: carveout applied. support-sam please notify customers of the config and ETA to re-enable funcalls.
support-sam: will notify api-cms and searchly now with the mitigation note and expected 30-60m window.
prod-ana: good. we should schedule a canary re-enable of funcalls in a low-traffic region once stability holds for 15m.
runtime-lee: agree. set alert for 15m stability and then canary in us-west-2 region with `funcall_enabled=true` for small fraction.
incident-bot: incident updated: mitigation applied (quotas lowered, funcall disabled), severity downgraded to P2. on-call: Jordan. pages suppressed for same signal for 10m.
oncall-jordan: monitoring. if p50 < 150ms and error rate normalizes for 15m we start rollback plan. otherwise escalate to infra and model teams.
sre-maya: logging this as handoff note: `thorn13b emergency rate sculpt -> quotas=25/15000, funcall=false, carveout={api-cms:500,searchly:300}`. will add to postmortem notes.
support-sam: customers notified. will collect any reported user impact and escalate if they report degraded UX.
oncall-jordan: thanks all. keeping thread open, will update on canary outcome.
runtime-lee: update in 12m: p50=140ms, errors back to baseline. ready to canary.
oncall-jordan: starting canary: enabling funcall for thorn13b in us-west-2 only (5% traffic). command posted.
runtime-lee: canary looks clean so far, no spike in KV churn.
oncall-jordan: rolling funcall re-enable to global at 30% then full over 10m if stable. will record final timestamps in postmortem.
incident-bot: incident resolved: full rollback completed at 1767204598. closing page.
